_comment: The 24 Elder Futhark runes as the game reads them. `order` is the futhark position (three eights); `six` is the game's grouping on top. `roadForm` is what a rune comes out as when the knife is a road: a shape the matcher knows, a note, a stop, or nothing yet. One gloss per rune; docs/WORLD.md has the rules for drawing them.

ROAD.name: the Road Six
ROAD.how: Found lying anywhere. Rune-stones work loose.

GROUND.name: the Ground Six
GROUND.how: Found only on their own kind of ground.

TRADE.name: the Trade Six
TRADE.how: Given by the trades, at the end of a chapter.

HARD.name: the Hard Six
HARD.how: Taken from the old ones and the elders.

runes.name: Fehu
runes.gloss: The toll-rune. What a road is owed.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.gloss: The ox. A hill is a thing you lean on.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.gloss: The thorn. A hedge is a wall that grows back.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.gloss: The word-rune. A place named is a place kept.

runes.name: Raido
runes.gloss: The road-rune. Cut it again and the way remembers you.

runes.name: Kenaz
runes.gloss: The torch. It shows what is there, which is not always welcome.

runes.name: Gebo
runes.gloss: The gift. Two ways meet and each gives the other somewhere to go.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.gloss: The glad rune. Roads were also for going somewhere pleasant.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.gloss: The hailstone. What comes down on ground nobody is minding.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.gloss: The need-rune. Cut it when short of something. It does not say what.

runes.name: Isa
runes.gloss: The ice. Stopping is also a way of being somewhere.

runes.name: Jera
runes.gloss: The year. What you did last season, coming due.

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.gloss: The yew. It outlasts whatever is built round it.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.gloss: The cup. Nobody agrees what it means, which is taken as proof.

runes.name: Algiz
runes.gloss: The sedge. Grab it and it cuts; follow it and it marks the dry way.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.gloss: The sun. A road goes somewhere; this is the somewhere.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.gloss: The guiding star. It points one way and has never been asked why.

runes.name: Berkano
runes.gloss: The birch. First tree back on cleared ground.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.gloss: The mount. Two going as one: you, and whatever you are on.

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.gloss: The passer-by. A road with nobody on it is a ditch.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.gloss: The water-rune. Water remembers every route that crossed it.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.gloss: The seed. A small closed shape with something kept in it.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.gloss: The day-rune. Dawn and dusk are the same mark seen from each side.

runes.name: Othala
runes.gloss: The enclosure. What is kept, and kept well.
